items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Oh Lemon, when I met, I met Lemon in a race in Louisiana.

ctx.x: What about Lemon? Did he ever play a youth band?
Oh Lemon, when I met, I met Lemon in a race in Louisiana. I met with a guitar. Yeah, he told me he played guitar and banjo.
He asked me to sit there, I told him I was a guitar, I would learn.
